name: Harbor State Bank
description: Harbor State Bank is a regional bank based in the United States that takes deposits from households and small businesses and lends them out as commercial loans, home mortgages and lines of credit through a network of local branches.

name: Midvale Bancorp
description: Midvale Bancorp runs a community lending franchise: checking and savings customers fund the balance sheet, which finances local companies, farms and homebuyers. Most income is net interest margin.

name: Thames County Bank
description: Thames County Bank, based in the United Kingdom, is a regional bank serving retail savers and small firms with current accounts, deposits, business loans and residential mortgages through local branches.

name: Rheinland Volksbank
description: Rheinland Volksbank is based in Germany and operates as a cooperative regional bank, collecting deposits from local members and providing loans to small and medium-sized businesses and households.

name: Prairie Trust Financial
description: The company is committed to long-term value creation, operational excellence and disciplined capital allocation. Its experienced management team focuses on customers, employees and shareholders, and it continues to invest in growth, innovation and sustainability across its markets. Prairie Trust Financial operates a regional bank that gathers deposits and makes commercial and consumer loans.

name: Keystone Home Loans
description: Keystone Home Loans originates and services residential mortgages in the United States, funding loans through warehouse lines and selling them into mortgage-backed securities while keeping servicing rights.

name: Brightdoor Mortgage
description: Brightdoor Mortgage helps families buy or refinance houses: it underwrites home loans online, packages them for government-sponsored agencies and earns fees from collecting borrower payments.

name: Maple Residential Lending
description: Maple Residential Lending, based in Canada, originates residential mortgages through brokers and sells insured mortgages into securitization programs, retaining servicing fees.

name: Northgate Mortgage Trust
description: Northgate Mortgage Trust originates residential mortgage loans for homebuyers and refinancing borrowers and earns servicing income on the loans it sells to investors.

name: Swiftpay Networks
description: Swiftpay Networks processes card payments for merchants, providing point-of-sale terminals, online checkout and settlement, and earns a fee on each transaction it processes.

name: Ledgerline
description: Ledgerline lets shops and websites accept money from shoppers: its gateway authorizes purchases, moves funds to sellers' accounts and charges a small percentage of every sale.

name: Euroclear Pay
description: Euroclear Pay is based in Germany and provides payment processing for European merchants, including card acquiring, online checkout and settlement of transactions.

name: Tokai Payment Systems
description: Tokai Payment Systems, based in Japan, runs a merchant acquiring business that processes credit card and QR code payments for retailers and charges transaction fees.

name: Coinbridge Merchant Services
description: The company is committed to long-term value creation, operational excellence and disciplined capital allocation. Its experienced management team focuses on customers, employees and shareholders, and it continues to invest in growth, innovation and sustainability across its markets. Coinbridge Merchant Services processes card transactions for small merchants.

name: Gale Ridge Energy
description: Gale Ridge Energy develops, owns and operates onshore wind farms in the United States and sells the electricity under long-term power purchase agreements with utilities.

name: Northsea Turbine Holdings
description: Northsea Turbine Holdings, based in the United Kingdom, operates offshore wind farms and sells renewable electricity to the grid under contracts for difference.

name: Highplains Renewables
description: Highplains Renewables builds fleets of turbines on leased ranch land and earns revenue by delivering clean generation to grid operators under multi-decade offtake contracts.

name: Brisa Power
description: Brisa Power is based in Germany and owns onshore wind parks that generate renewable electricity sold under feed-in tariffs and power purchase agreements.

name: Westerly Wind Partners
description: Westerly Wind Partners owns wind farms and sells the electricity they generate to utilities through long-term power purchase agreements.

name: Sunmesa Power
description: Sunmesa Power develops and operates utility-scale solar farms in the United States and sells the electricity under long-term power purchase agreements.

name: Photon Fields
description: Photon Fields installs photovoltaic panels across desert acreage and earns contracted revenue by supplying daytime generation and battery-shifted output to grid operators.

name: Iberia Sol Renovables
description: Iberia Sol Renovables, based in Spain, owns solar photovoltaic plants and sells the electricity under power purchase agreements and in the wholesale market.

name: Rooftop Grid Co
description: The company is committed to long-term value creation, operational excellence and disciplined capital allocation. Its experienced management team focuses on customers, employees and shareholders, and it continues to invest in growth, innovation and sustainability across its markets. Rooftop Grid Co owns solar installations and sells the electricity they produce.

name: Permian Rig Services
description: Permian Rig Services provides contract drilling rigs and crews to oil and gas producers in the United States, earning day rates for drilling horizontal wells.

name: Deepwater Bore
description: Deepwater Bore, based in the United Kingdom, operates offshore drilling rigs that it charters to oil companies on day-rate contracts.

name: Basin Wellworks
description: Basin Wellworks, based in Canada, leases its fleet of land rigs and crews to exploration companies that need new hydrocarbon wells, billing per day of operation.

name: Gulf Coast Drilling
description: Gulf Coast Drilling owns jackup and land drilling rigs and contracts them to oil and gas producers at day rates.

name: Clearpath Diagnostics
description: Clearpath Diagnostics makes blood testing analysers, reagents and point-of-care test kits for hospital and reference laboratories, with recurring revenue from consumables.

name: Assaygen
description: Assaygen places instruments in clinical labs and then sells the chemistry cartridges those machines consume to measure patient samples for disease markers.

name: Rhine Labor Diagnostik
description: Rhine Labor Diagnostik is based in Germany and supplies laboratory analysers, reagents and test kits to hospitals and clinical laboratories.

name: Kanto Medical Testing
description: Kanto Medical Testing, based in Japan, manufactures diagnostic analysers and reagents for blood and urine testing in hospital laboratories.

name: Veritas Assay Group
description: Veritas Assay Group sells diagnostic analysers, reagents and test consumables to hospital laboratories.

name: Stridewell Orthopedics
description: Stridewell Orthopedics designs and sells hip and knee replacement implants and surgical instruments to hospitals and orthopedic surgeons.

name: Jointcraft Medical
description: Jointcraft Medical makes artificial joints and the tools surgeons use to fit them, helping patients with arthritis walk again after replacement procedures.

name: Alpine Spine Systems
description: Alpine Spine Systems, based in Switzerland, develops spinal implants, bone screws and orthopedic surgical instruments sold to hospitals.

name: Bonebridge Implants
description: The company is committed to long-term value creation, operational excellence and disciplined capital allocation. Its experienced management team focuses on customers, employees and shareholders, and it continues to invest in growth, innovation and sustainability across its markets. Bonebridge Implants sells knee and hip implants to orthopedic surgeons.

name: Paydeck Software
description: Paydeck Software provides cloud payroll and human resources software that lets employers run payroll, manage benefits and track employee time, sold as a monthly subscription per employee.

name: Crewbase
description: Crewbase gives companies one online place to pay staff, file wage taxes, onboard new hires and handle workforce records, charging a subscription for each worker.

name: Peoplegrid
description: Peoplegrid, based in the United Kingdom, sells cloud human resources and payroll software to mid-sized employers on a subscription basis.

name: Talentloop
description: Talentloop is based in Germany and offers subscription software for payroll, time tracking and human resources administration.

name: Staffline Cloud
description: Staffline Cloud sells payroll processing and HR management software to small businesses as a subscription service.

name: Bastion Security
description: Bastion Security sells endpoint protection and threat detection software that stops malware and ransomware on corporate laptops and servers, on an annual subscription.

name: Nightwatch Labs
description: Nightwatch Labs monitors corporate networks around the clock, spotting intruders and shutting down attacks before data is stolen, for customers paying yearly licences.

name: Shieldware
description: Shieldware, based in Israel, develops firewall and cloud security software that protects enterprise networks from cyberattacks, sold by subscription.

name: Cipherline
description: The company is committed to long-term value creation, operational excellence and disciplined capital allocation. Its experienced management team focuses on customers, employees and shareholders, and it continues to invest in growth, innovation and sustainability across its markets. Cipherline sells cybersecurity software that detects and blocks threats.

name: Bluewater Container Lines
description: Bluewater Container Lines operates a fleet of container ships carrying cargo between Asian and North American ports, earning freight rates per container.

name: Hanseatic Box Shipping
description: Hanseatic Box Shipping is based in Germany and runs container vessels on liner routes between Europe and Asia, charging freight rates for each container moved.

name: Oceanic Freight Carriers
description: Oceanic Freight Carriers, based in Singapore, moves exporters' goods across the Pacific in standard steel boxes aboard its own vessels, billing per box and voyage.

name: Tidewater Liner Co
description: Tidewater Liner Co owns container ships and charters vessels to carry containerized cargo on transpacific routes.

name: Interstate Haulers
description: Interstate Haulers provides truckload freight transportation across the United States with a fleet of tractors and trailers, earning revenue per mile hauled.

name: Roadrunner Logistics
description: Roadrunner Logistics moves retailers' pallets between warehouses and stores using its own big rigs and drivers, billing shippers by the load.

name: Northern Freightways
description: Northern Freightways, based in Canada, runs less-than-truckload and truckload trucking services with a fleet of tractors and trailers.

name: Autobahn Spedition
description: Autobahn Spedition is based in Germany and operates road freight trucking services for manufacturers and retailers across Europe.

name: Burgerbarn
description: Burgerbarn operates and franchises quick-service restaurants serving burgers, fries and shakes, earning royalties from franchisees and sales from company-owned restaurants.

name: Tacoloco
description: Tacoloco runs fast counter-service eateries selling tacos and burritos, most of them owned by local operators who pay it a share of their sales.

name: Maple Fry House
description: Maple Fry House, based in Canada, franchises quick-service restaurants serving fries, burgers and coffee.

name: Wurst Express
description: The company is committed to long-term value creation, operational excellence and disciplined capital allocation. Its experienced management team focuses on customers, employees and shareholders, and it continues to invest in growth, innovation and sustainability across its markets. Wurst Express is based in Germany and franchises quick-service restaurants serving sausages and fries.

name: Gale Ridge Energy Holdings
description: Gale Ridge Energy develops, owns and operates onshore wind farms in the United States and sells the electricity under long-term power purchase agreements with utilities.
